searchText: okay, v0.1.0 of mergemock cut with support for registration batching: https://github.com/protolambda/mergemock/releases/tag/v0.1.0 just tagged mev-boost v0.4.5 which is compatible with the latest specs (<@543900561460822016> pls link it in the interop spec) cool thanks! fyi, mergemock does not currently build blocks with validator prefs (despite storing them): https://github.com/protolambda/mergemock/pull/46 PSA - We've upgraded our kiln builder at https://builder-relay-kiln.flashbots.net to the latest spec (using an array for validator registrations), any single-item registrations will be rejected. > Each block has a target size of 15 million gas but the size of blocks will increase or decrease in accordance with network demands, up until the block limit of 30 million gas (2x target block size). question, how much can it move up and down per block? +/- `parentGasLimit / 1024`

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: okay, v0.1.0 of mergemock cut with support for registration batching: https://github.com/protolambda/mergemock/releases/tag/v0.1.0

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: fyi, mergemock does not currently build blocks with validator prefs (despite storing them): https://github.com/protolambda/mergemock/pull/46

excerpts.author: metachris_
excerpts.content: PSA - We've upgraded our kiln builder at https://builder-relay-kiln.flashbots.net to the latest spec (using an array for validator registrations), any single-item registrations will be rejected.
